home.eyebrow: A grow journal for personal growers
home.title: The grow journal that remembers every run.
home.intro: Plan your grow, log feeds and photos, and ask AI with your grow's history attached — free to start.

sections.title: Personal growers
sections.body: Stop piecing together phone photos, feeding notes, and calendar reminders. Keep tasks, feeds, readings, and photos in one grow timeline so you can look back at what changed.

sections.title: Commercial creators
sections.body: Keep product trials and grow results together, then share what you know through courses, eligible storefront products, and live sessions.

sections.title: Facilities
sections.body: Know which room needs attention, who is doing the work, and what was recorded. Keep room readings, tasks, SOP checklists, and reports connected.

features.title: Tools appear where the work happens
features.intro: The Tools page is a library. GrowPathAI also launches the same tools from grows, plants, logs, tasks, photos, harvests, courses, and facility workspaces.

sections.title: Plan and schedule
sections.body: Start-a-grow planning, grow calendars, watering, feeding, timelines, and recurring tasks create real work items.

sections.title: Observe and diagnose

pricing.title: Start free and keep what you create

sections.title: Free

sections.title: Pro Grower — $10/month or $100/year
sections.body: For growers who need more room: 10 grows, 50 plants, and 100 AI credits each week. Annual billing is charged as one $100 payment; save $20 compared with 12 monthly payments.

sections.title: Commercial — $50/month or $500/year
sections.body: For brands and sellers: 50 grows, 500 plants, and 500 AI credits each week, plus storefront, course, campaign, inventory, and trial workflows. Annual billing is charged as one $500 payment; save $100 compared with 12 monthly payments.

sections.title: Facility — $100/month or $1,000/year
sections.body: For room-based team work: 200 grows, 2,000 plants, and a shared Facility pool of 2,000 AI credits each week. Annual billing is charged as one $1,000 payment; save $200 compared with 12 monthly payments.

sections.title: Many grow types

sections.title: Support requests
sections.body: Include your GrowPathAI account email, workspace type, page, what you expected, and what happened.

sections.title: Creator applications
sections.body: Include your name, account email, channel information, social links, requested account type, and what you plan to test.

sections.title: Security and safety
sections.body: Do not send passwords, controller credentials, payment details, or sensitive evidence through ordinary support messages.

ai-cultivation-disclaimer.title: AI is decision support, not a guarantee
ai-cultivation-disclaimer.intro: GrowPathAI can organize context, calculate values, identify patterns, and suggest questions or next steps. Its output may be incomplete or wrong and must be reviewed.

sections.title: Cultivation
sections.body: Confirm diagnoses and treatments using direct observation, labels, trusted references, testing, and qualified local professionals.

sections.title: Safety and compliance
sections.body: Follow product labels, workplace procedures, local laws, licensing rules, and environmental and food-safety requirements.

sections.title: Privacy
sections.body: Avoid entering secrets or unnecessary personal information. Review what grow, plant, photo, and account context is attached before submitting.

vs/plntrk.title: GrowPathAI and PLNTRK: compare the work you need to do
vs/plntrk.intro: Both keep grow records and offer AI help. Choose by your plant count, day-to-day logging, export needs, and whether you also need courses, storefront work, or a facility workspace.

sections.title: PLNTRK: plant-first tracking
sections.body: PLNTRK's published Pro plans include plant photos, logs, AI help, and QR/NFC logging. Pro 25 is $35/year for up to 25 plants; Pro 100 is $90/year for up to 100 plants. Check its checkout for current prices and terms.

sections.title: GrowPathAI: a grow record connected to your next task
sections.body: Start Free with 1 grow, 1 plant, and 5 AI credits per week. Pro Grower is $10/month or $100/year for 10 grows, 50 plants, and 100 weekly AI credits. Commercial and Facility plans cover different business and team workflows.

sections.title: Can I export my records?
sections.body: PLNTRK documents CSV grow-data exports and a plant PDF with photos and logs. GrowPathAI offers supported timeline/report exports plus an account-export request in Profile privacy controls. Check the export you need before committing a season of records.
sections.linkLabel: Source: PLNTRK export and privacy FAQ

sections.title: Where does my data live?
sections.body: These are cloud-backed services, not a guarantee of local-only storage. PLNTRK's FAQ describes cloud backup. GrowPathAI's Terms say you retain ownership of your content; its Privacy page explains processing and export/deletion requests.

sections.title: Is GrowPathAI always the cheaper choice?
sections.body: No. PLNTRK's advertised Pro 25 annual price is lower than GrowPathAI Pro Grower. Compare the plant limit and workflows you will actually use, not just a feature count. This comparison is written by GrowPathAI, not an independent review.

vs/grow-with-jane.title: GrowPathAI and Grow with Jane: choose your grow journal
vs/grow-with-jane.intro: Both organize grow records and offer contextual AI assistance. Try the logging workflow, check the limits, and test an export before you commit a whole grow.

sections.title: Grow with Jane: a mobile grow journal and community
sections.body: Grow with Jane offers plant and environment tracking, public growlogs, growing guides, and community discussions. Its website links to iOS and Android downloads. Check the app store for current subscription prices in your country; we have not verified a single universal price.

sections.title: GrowPathAI: journal, tasks, and connected workspaces
sections.body: Free includes 1 grow, 1 plant, and 5 weekly AI credits. Pro Grower is $10/month or $100/year for 10 grows, 50 plants, and 100 weekly AI credits. Commercial and Facility plans add separate brand or team workflows.

sections.title: Does only GrowPathAI use grow history with AI?
sections.body: No. Jane AI also accepts selected plants, environments, photos, and supported growlog context. GrowPathAI likewise attaches relevant grow history when you start from supported records. Neither AI system guarantees a correct diagnosis.
sections.linkLabel: Source: Jane AI's context and limitations

sections.title: Can I keep an export?
sections.body: Grow with Jane's support discussion describes browser Print → Save as PDF as a growlog workaround, rather than a complete in-app export. GrowPathAI has supported timeline/report exports and account-export requests. Test whether the output includes the photos and records you need.
sections.linkLabel: Source: Grow with Jane export discussion

sections.title: Who owns my records?
sections.body: GrowPathAI's Terms say your content remains yours and its Privacy page describes cloud processing and account-export requests. Review each service's privacy terms separately before uploading sensitive records. This is GrowPathAI's comparison, not an independent review.

pricingFaq.title: Is Free a trial that turns into a bill?
pricingFaq.body: No. The Free plan has no subscription charge and does not require a payment card. It includes 1 tracked grow, 1 tracked plant, and 5 AI credits per week. A paid plan is a separate checkout choice. Plan terms and limits may change; see the Terms of Service.

pricingFaq.title: What does one AI credit buy?
pricingFaq.body: A standard AI assistant request uses 1 credit and a standard plant diagnosis uses 3. For example, Free's 5 weekly credits can cover 5 assistant requests, or 1 diagnosis and 2 assistant requests. Other AI workflows can have different costs; check the displayed cost before starting. Credits reset weekly, not monthly. Facility work uses the Facility's shared pool, not 2,000 credits for each team member.

pricingFaq.title: What happens when I reach a limit?
pricingFaq.body: An AI action needs enough credits before it can run; wait for the next weekly reset or review the available plan options. Grow and plant limits restrict adding more tracked records. They do not mean that existing records are automatically deleted. You do not have to buy a plan just to keep your account.

pricingFaq.title: Do I still own my photos and grow records?
pricingFaq.body: Yes. Under our Terms, you retain ownership of the content you add. GrowPathAI is a cloud service, not an offline-only local notebook. We store and process records through service providers to run the app. Review Privacy for how account information, photos, and other records are handled.

pricingFaq.title: Can I take my records with me?
pricingFaq.body: Supported timeline and report screens provide exports where your plan and role allow them. You can also request an account export from Profile's privacy controls. These are different export paths: do not assume a timeline PDF is a complete backup of every original photo or every account record.

pricingFaq.title: How do payments and cancellation work?
pricingFaq.body: Paid checkout is handled by Stripe; GrowPathAI does not store full card numbers. Manage an existing subscription from Account Billing. Review the cancellation effective date before confirming. Annual prices are charged in one payment, not monthly installments. Refund eligibility follows the terms shown for the purchase; we do not promise an unconditional money-back guarantee.

pricingFaq.title: Which plan should I choose?
pricingFaq.body: Start Free for one grow and one plant. Pro Grower adds room for 10 grows and 50 plants at $10/month or $100/year. Choose Commercial for brand and storefront workflows, or Facility for room-based team operations. Facility credits are shared within that workspace. These are different workflow plans, not a promise of unlimited seats, usage, or device integrations.

scope: GrowPathAI keeps records and helps you review them. It is not an automatic grow controller, a guarantee of plant health or yield, or a substitute for professional advice. Ordinary public storefronts do not process cannabis sales.
